cs.t: Nothing under $200 sadly: * danner boots. Get stitchdown construction models that can be recrafted. * James brand knives. Incredible build quality for an American brand * Garmin handheld GPS units. Don’t know how they can make a device that powers on without issue 10 years after purchasing (woo, AA battery support), but they can’t do UI to save their lives! * grovemade metal/leather wallets. They don’t make these any more. I have a brass wallet that cards slide into and out of. The leather will probably fall off one day and I’ll glue more on. * hardwood furniture. You don’t need to get branded ones; Home Goods has nice options. Look for items made in india, especially with Acadia wood, which usually has a pretty gain and holds up well over time - protip, this is where west elm and crate and barrel source a lot of things from too! No MDF for me! * best made metal toolboxes. RIP, best made co, but the toolboxes I got from them will last forever.
